question: Should OpenClaw add first-party per-agent backup/restore/clone CLI support now, and what credential plus transcript portability policy should that feature enforce?
rationale: The request is useful and core-adjacent, but it adds new CLI flags and restore behavior that can rewrite sensitive persisted state, so automation cannot choose the product and security boundary safely.

options.title: Sponsor a core design
options.body: Define the per-agent archive manifest, credential/session portability rules, rollback behavior, and tests before accepting implementation work.

options.title: Fold into broader backup work
options.body: Wait for the broader backup/restore snapshot direction to settle, then add agent scoping as part of that format rather than as a separate command path.

options.title: Decline core clone support
options.body: Document manual or external tooling expectations instead, accepting that multi-agent recovery remains fragile but avoiding new core restore risk.

recommendation.title: Sponsor a core design
recommendation.body: Define the per-agent archive manifest, credential/session portability rules, rollback behavior, and tests before accepting implementation work.

likelyOwner.reason: Best available routing candidate from recent backup-area history and maintainer-side decision context.
